seoTitle: Gérard & Fils - Office, business and shop removals
seoDesc: Moving your company offices or commercial premises? Trust the Gérard & Fils team to take care of everything.

body.p: For companies wanting to move into larger or better-located premises, Gérard & Fils provides a dedicated team of experts. Whether it is a shop, offices or any other business space, we organise a complete move within the Brussels region, designed to meet your specific needs.

Aware of the importance of keeping your business running, we do everything we can to work quickly and efficiently. Thanks to proven methods and modern, high-performance tools, our team guarantees a seamless transfer, allowing you to resume operations under the best possible conditions.

We support you from A to Z in your project, from the handover of the specification to putting your equipment and furniture back in place. We pack, protect and transport IT equipment, furniture and archives with the greatest care, communicating clearly with the project manager throughout the operation. We ensure strict compliance with the agreed deadlines and all your requirements. Our team of responsive, experienced removers is trained to deal with any situation that may arise during the process. Whether your offices are on the top floor of a building and hard to reach, or you have particularly bulky or fragile equipment to transport, we always find suitable solutions. You can count on Gérard & Fils for the secure transport of your goods: we have suitable handling equipment and vehicles of different capacities to meet your expectations in every respect. Careful planning, well-timed organisation of the different stages and meticulous work are the guarantees our company offers.

sections.h: Qualified removers in every municipality of Brussels

body.p: Trust our team to handle the transfer of your shop under the best possible conditions. We do everything we can to limit interruptions to your business and ensure smooth organisation. Thanks to our experience, you benefit from complete and efficient support for your move to Ixelles. A detailed, free quote will be sent to you promptly.

Our specialists also support you with your company relocation projects. Whether it is a small office or a larger organisation, we have suitable solutions to meet your needs in Etterbeek. Contact us today to discuss it.

You can reach us on 0484 / 13 16 81 or 02 / 215 08 46 for any appointment request or further information. You can also send us a message using our form to find out our rates and receive a free quote for your move.
